answers.sql: SELECT transfer_units AS value FROM releases WHERE period='P1' AND published_on<='2024-07-05' ORDER BY published_on DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT transfer_units AS value FROM releases WHERE period='P2' AND published_on<='2024-07-05' ORDER BY published_on DESC LIMIT 1

WITH selected AS (SELECT period,transfer_units FROM releases AS r WHERE published_on<='2024-07-05' AND published_on=(SELECT MAX(r2.published_on) FROM releases AS r2 WHERE r2.period=r.period AND r2.published_on<='2024-07-05')) SELECT 100.0*((SELECT transfer_units FROM selected WHERE period='P2')-(SELECT transfer_units FROM selected WHERE period='P1'))/(SELECT transfer_units FROM selected WHERE period='P1') AS value
